_about: Backend test modules known to fail on each platform (sys.platform), and why. scripts/backend-tests-by-module.py --known turns any other failing module red and names each listed one that now passes, so this list only shrinks. Never add a module to make a build green without the reason being true.

linux.test_app_update: The Mac in-app update (ditto, .app bundles). Linux's own update is tested in test_linux_update.
linux.test_openrouter_loop: The OpenRouter loop runs under macOS sandbox-exec; it's a personal-experimental Mac feature.
linux.test_rust_setup: Rust checks run only on a Mac for now (check_profiles.LINUX_DETAIL).
linux.test_beta_plan: Baseline on every platform: the plan commits it reads aren't in this repository.
linux.test_project_scope: Baseline on every platform: test_creation_conflicts_and_denials expects credentials.py and auth_token.py refused, which project_access deliberately allows for source files.
linux.test_typescript_inputs: Baseline on every platform since the phone companion merge: frontend/tsconfig.json gained a tweetnacl path alias, and search_fixture refuses any alias change until the selection is reviewed.
linux.test_independent_review: Baseline on every platform since the phone companion merge: frontend/tsconfig.json gained a tweetnacl path alias, and search_fixture refuses any alias change until the selection is reviewed.
linux.test_thread_filing: Baseline on every platform since the routing merge: test_threads_named_after_their_first_message_get_short_names_and_workstreams_once expects the migration to add no tables, and it now adds routing_decisions.
